evidence_items.explanation: Reuters documents losses among Chinese retail investors and describes perceived official support as one investor's motivation. This establishes neither media causation nor losses in US 401(k)s; no primary account records were available.

The report describes record average second-quarter 401(k) balances, with both market recovery and contributions contributing. Aggregate balances do not isolate media effects, individual losses, or subsequent October performance.
